          The pool

          One difficulty at a time: the rank you hold on each scenario, the score for the next one, and what your last run reached. Highlighted rows count toward your next rank.

          Most scenarios also appear in community benchmarks. The marks under a name are the other benchmarks that scenario counts on, filled once your score holds a rank there. Hover for the rank and next threshold.

          Playlists

          How ranks work: tiers, bands and category ladders

          Overall tier

          by population percentile

          Standing across all 6 categories. Tiers are population percentiles, so they stay stable as the player base grows.

          Category ladders

          four overlapping difficulty bands

          4 bands per category, each with its own ranks. Bands overlap by 2 ranks, so the next band's first ranks can be reached from this one. The overall tier is derived from all 6 categories.

          Beyond the top rank

          Your position on each scenario's KovaaK's leaderboard, with no ceiling. Each full point means 10x fewer players above you.

          Admin

          Repaint the chrome and rewrite the copy, on this machine. Rank names and colours are written back to the season and validated the same way the app validates any other season edit.

          Chrome

          Every colour in the client that is not a rank. Changes show as you make them; nothing is written until you save.

          Copy

          Static app text. Values computed from runs are not listed.

          Rank names and colours

          These belong to the season, not to this machine, so they save through the season and are refused once it is published. Contrast against the ground is measured beside each one.

          Store

          Overrides live on this machine only. Export writes the current set to a file you can keep, commit as the shipped defaults, or hand to another install.

          Season

          Edit categories, scenarios and rank thresholds. Your draft is backed up locally as you work.

          Looking for your KovaaK's stats…

          Apogee finds the stats folder by itself on most installs.

          Where is it?

          Usually Steam\steamapps\common\FPSAimTrainer\FPSAimTrainer\stats. Picking the Steam or FPSAimTrainer folder also works; Apogee looks inside it.

          A fresh KovaaK's install has no stats until its first run is played.
